text_blocks.snippet: Opsumit (macitentan) can cause common, mild side effects as well as serious medical issues. You can read more about safety details on the Official Opsumit Site.

list.snippet: Stuffy or runny nose, sore throat, or common cold symptoms
Inflammation or irritation of the airways (bronchitis)
Urinary tract infections (kidney or bladder infections)
Low red blood cell levels (anemia), which can cause unusual tiredness or weakness

Fluid retention and swelling: Swelling in your hands, legs, ankles, or feet, or rapid weight gain can happen within the first few weeks. This can sometimes lead to serious breathing trouble or heart failure.
Liver damage: Signs include nausea, vomiting, fever, upper right stomach pain, loss of appetite, dark urine, or yellowing of your skin or eyes.
Fetal harm and birth defects: Opsumit causes severe birth defects if taken during pregnancy. Strict pregnancy prevention and monthly testing are required for individuals who can become pregnant.
Decreased sperm count: The medication can lower sperm production and affect male fertility.

text_blocks.snippet: Talk to your doctor right away if you notice any severe swelling, breathing changes, or signs of liver problems.
